description: How to make a cheese at home, step by step (przepis krok po kroku): the full recipe by name or id, e.g. "mozzarella", "gouda", "camembert", "twaróg", ready to show as a recipe card. Ingredients with amount and unit (składniki: mleko, kultura, podpuszczka, chlorek wapnia, sól), steps with temperature in °C and time in minutes, salting (solenie), ripening (dojrzewanie), tips and warnings, and the brewing diary of the author when there is one. Plus the cultures from the recipe matched to Polish shops (shop, price with date, price per litre, link) and other cultures that suit this cheese. [Moduł wiedzy Moja Serowarnia, https://mojaserowarnia.pl; hub przekazuje pytanie do jego serwera]
